purpose: diagnostic only, NOT used in the manuscript
question: can the companion study's in-sample AUROC 1.00 -> LODO AUROC 0.497 be re-derived from this project's own frozen cervical embeddings?
input: results/dump_cervix.json (35 slice-level embeddings, 128 dim, ordinal severity 0/1/2; 31 normal, 4 neoplastic)
probe: closed-form ridge alpha=1, standardised inside the training fold, leave-one-donor-out, same family as the tau_LDO probe
conclusion: there is no collapse on this cohort: slice-level LODO AUROC is 0.73-0.97 and tau_in 0.462 falls only to tau_LOO 0.42 (retention 0.92). The companion's 1.00 -> 0.497 must come from a different evaluation unit or a different model, so it cannot be cited as corroboration on the same structure.
